issues: 0:00-0:04 (title): The spoken narration ('Two AI loops. One cheated.') measures 4.2s against a 4s segment, clipping the end of 'cheated' right at the cut.
0:04-0:09 (problem): The caption ('GOAL: CLEAR 3 GATES, LAND SOFTLY, HIT A 9/10 CRITIC SCORE.') wraps onto three lines in a tall dark box that obscures the Verdicts cards on the results page.

0:09-0:14 (loops): While the voiceover says both loops aced 16 of 16, the page on screen already displays 'held-out 0/64' for the gamed loop and 'Fresh sandboxes: Honest loop recipe' thumbnails, which are partly covered by the caption.

0:14-0:19 (cheat): The caption ('THE CHEAT: 222 TOKENS OF MEMORIZED SEEDS AND COPIED PHYSICS.') misstates the 222-token figure—both the facts and the on-screen text state that the seed list alone is 222 tokens, excluding the copied physics. The 4.7s line also leaves almost no breathing room in the 5s shot.

0:19-0:25 (recipes): Story clarity gap—neither the caption nor the voiceover explains what happens to the 32-token recipes (that fresh agents in clean sandboxes rebuild the controller from the recipe alone). The 4.5s line in a 6s shot also leaves 1.5s of dead air (0:23.5-0:25).

0:25-0:32 (verdicts): The voiceover ('New flights: cheater zero. Its rebuilds, sixty-point-five.') omits the denominator (64 flights) and references 'rebuilds' without having explained them, while the three-line caption covers the bottom of the verdict cards.
0:32-0:40 (honest): The 4.8s line finishes at 0:36.8, leaving over 3 seconds of dead air while the honest drone finishes its 16s flight replay.

0:44-0:52 (rebuild): The shot opens on a 'Loading recorded flight...' state for the first second (0:44-0:45), and the 4.5s narration finishes at 0:48.5, leaving 3.5s of dead air and missing the deadpan punchline that the rebuild beat the honest drone and landed 3.5 mm from center.
0:52-0:57 (end): The caption ('CHEATS DON'T FIT IN 32 TOKENS.') wraps awkwardly with 'TOKENS.' orphaned on a second line.
untrue: In segment 'cheat' (0:14-0:19), the caption claims '222 TOKENS OF MEMORIZED SEEDS AND COPIED PHYSICS', whereas FACTS ('seed_list_tokens': 222) and the on-screen page text state that the seed list alone is 222 tokens.
